def is_nested(string):
    open_count = 0
    close_count = 0
    
    for i, bracket in enumerate(string):
        if bracket == '[':
            open_count += 1
        elif bracket == ']':
            close_count += 1
        
        # Check if there are at least two pairs of brackets forming a nested structure
        if open_count >= 2 and close_count >= 2:
            return True
    
    # Ensure the string is balanced before returning False
    return open_count == close_count

# Test cases
print(is_nested('[[]]'))       # ➞ True
print(is_nested('[]]]]]]][[[[[]'))   # ➞ False
print(is_nested('[][]'))      # ➞ False
print(is_nested('[]'))        # ➞ False
print(is_nested('[[][]]'))    # ➞ True
print(is_nested('[[]][['))    # ➞ True
